units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“此天灾倘再延续，世界恐将毁灭！”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "If this natural disaster continues any longer, the world may be destroyed!"

units.source_text: 到了次日，破晓即刮飓风，海啸奔腾而来，

en.t: By the next day, a hurricane was already blowing at daybreak, and a surging tsunami came rushing in,

units.source_text: 巨浪扑岸，轰声震天，有排山倒海之势。

en.t: huge waves struck the shore, their roar shook the heavens, and they seemed powerful enough to topple mountains and overturn the sea.

units.source_text: 雷鸣电闪，竟像落在头上，恐怖难于言喻。

en.t: Thunder crashed and lightning flashed, seeming to fall right above their heads; the terror was beyond words.

units.source_text: 随从诸人，没有一个不惊惶失措。

en.t: Among all the attendants, not one failed to panic and lose composure.

units.source_text: 相与叹道：“我们前生犯了什么罪过，

en.t: They lamented to one another, "What sins did we commit in a previous life,
that we should suffer such hardship in this life!

units.source_text: 父母和亲爱的妻子儿女的面也见不着，

en.t: Unable even to see the faces of our parents and our beloved wives and children,
are we really to die like this?"

units.source_text: 只有源氏公子一人镇静，他想：“我毕竟有何罪过？

en.t: Only Prince Genji remained calm. He thought, "What sin, after all, have I committed?

units.source_text: 莫非要客死在这海边不成？”便强自振作。

en.t: Am I truly to die a stranger's death here by the sea?" Then he forced himself to rally his spirits.

units.source_text: 但周围的人骚扰不定，只得教人备办种种祭品，

en.t: But the people around him remained restless and agitated, so he had no choice but to order various offerings prepared,

units.source_text: 向神祈祷：“住吉大神呵！请守护此境！

en.t: and he prayed to the deity, "Great God of Sumiyoshi! Please protect this place!

units.source_text: 神灵显赫，定能拯救我等无罪之人。”

en.t: Your divine power is glorious; surely you can save us innocent people."
Thus he made a great and solemn vow.
